title: Backend Developer

nodes.title: Internet Protocols & Networking Fundamentals
nodes.subtitle: TCP/IP, UDP, DNS resolution, HTTP/1.1 vs HTTP/2 vs HTTP/3, TLS/SSL handshake
learning_objectives: Explain how TCP provides reliable, ordered transmission compared to UDP
Analyze the phases of an HTTPS TLS 1.3 handshake
feynman_prompts: Why does TCP require a 3-way handshake before transmitting data while UDP does not?
key_misconceptions: Assuming HTTPS encrypts IP addresses and domain names during DNS lookup without DoH

nodes.title: Backend Language Runtime & Concurrency Models
nodes.subtitle: Process memory model, threads, async event loop vs thread pool, I/O multiplexing
learning_objectives: Differentiate CPU-bound from I/O-bound bottlenecks in backend services
Implement non-blocking asynchronous request handlers
feynman_prompts: Explain why a single-threaded event loop can handle 10,000 concurrent I/O connections.
key_misconceptions: Running long CPU-intensive algorithms directly on the asynchronous event loop thread

nodes.title: Dependency Management & Project Architecture
nodes.subtitle: Virtual environments, package managers, configuration management, 12-factor app
learning_objectives: Structure clean multi-layered backend projects (controller, service, repository)
Manage environment variables and secrets following Twelve-Factor principles
feynman_prompts: Why should configuration and secrets never be committed into source code repositories?
key_misconceptions: Hardcoding database connection strings and secrets in application source files

nodes.title: Relational Databases & SQL Foundations
nodes.subtitle: PostgreSQL/MySQL, tables, primary/foreign keys, joins, aggregations, schema design
learning_objectives: Design normalized relational database schemas with foreign key constraints
Write efficient SQL queries using INNER, LEFT, and FULL OUTER joins
feynman_prompts: Explain the difference between WHERE (row filter) and HAVING (group filter) in SQL queries.
key_misconceptions: Assuming database foreign keys are purely for documentation without checking constraint costs

nodes.title: Database Indexing & Query Execution Plans
nodes.subtitle: B-Tree indexes, composite indexes, EXPLAIN ANALYZE, table scans vs index scans
learning_objectives: Diagnose slow queries using EXPLAIN ANALYZE and inspect execution plans
Create composite indexes adhering to the leftmost prefix rule
feynman_prompts: Why does adding an index speed up SELECT queries but slow down INSERT and UPDATE operations?
key_misconceptions: Adding indexes to every single column blindly, degrading write throughput

nodes.title: ACID Transactions & Concurrency Isolation Levels
nodes.subtitle: Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation, Durability, dirty reads, non-repeatable reads, phantom reads
learning_objectives: Execute multi-step database operations safely inside transactional boundaries
Select appropriate isolation levels (Read Committed, Repeatable Read, Serializable)
feynman_prompts: How does a database prevent dirty reads in the Read Committed isolation level?
key_misconceptions: Assuming transactions are completely isolated by default without checking the database isolation level

nodes.title: ORM Patterns & Database Migration Strategies
nodes.subtitle: SQLAlchemy/Prisma/Hibernate, active record vs data mapper, schema migrations, N+1 problem
learning_objectives: Execute safe, versioned database schema migrations with zero-downtime rollback
Detect and eliminate the N+1 query problem using eager loading / joins
feynman_prompts: Explain how the N+1 query problem occurs and how eager loading solves it.
key_misconceptions: Relying on ORM auto-generated queries without inspecting the underlying SQL in production

nodes.title: RESTful API Architecture & HTTP Contracts
nodes.subtitle: HTTP verbs, idempotent operations, status codes, OpenAPI/Swagger, error formats
learning_objectives: Design intuitive REST endpoints adhering to standard HTTP semantics
Format structured error responses following RFC 7807 problem details
feynman_prompts: Why is an HTTP PUT request idempotent while an HTTP POST request is not?
key_misconceptions: Returning HTTP 200 OK with an error message in the JSON response payload

nodes.title: Request Validation & Serialization
nodes.subtitle: Schema validation, Pydantic/Zod, input sanitization, type coercion, payload validation
learning_objectives: Enforce strict schema validation on all incoming API request payloads
Sanitize and reject untrusted input before it reaches service business logic
feynman_prompts: Why must API request validation happen at the perimeter before calling business services?
key_misconceptions: Trusting client data types without server-side validation

nodes.title: Authentication: JWT, Sessions & Password Hashing
nodes.subtitle: Stateful sessions vs stateless JWTs, bcrypt/argon2 hashing, refresh token rotation
learning_objectives: Hash passwords securely using bcrypt with appropriate work factor / cost
Implement stateless JWT authentication with short-lived access tokens and refresh tokens
feynman_prompts: Why is it dangerous to hash user passwords with fast algorithms like MD5 or SHA-256?
key_misconceptions: Storing sensitive claims (passwords, PII) inside unencrypted JWT payloads

nodes.title: Authorization: RBAC & Policy Enforcement
nodes.subtitle: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC), middleware guards
learning_objectives: Enforce granular user role and permission checks on API routes
Protect resources against Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA/IDOR)
feynman_prompts: Explain the difference between Authentication (who you are) and Authorization (what you can do).
key_misconceptions: Relying only on UI button hiding for access control without backend route authorization

nodes.title: Caching Strategies with Redis
nodes.subtitle: In-memory caching, Cache-Aside pattern, Write-Through, TTL expiration, cache invalidation
learning_objectives: Implement the Cache-Aside pattern with Redis to reduce primary database load
Set appropriate TTLs and handle cache invalidation on resource updates
feynman_prompts: What is a Cache Stampede (Thundering Herd) and how can it be mitigated?
key_misconceptions: Treating Redis as a permanent database without persistence or eviction configurations

nodes.title: NoSQL Databases: Document & Key-Value Stores
nodes.subtitle: MongoDB, Redis, eventual consistency, denormalization, CAP theorem trade-offs
learning_objectives: Model denormalized document schemas for read-heavy application workflows
Evaluate the CAP theorem trade-offs between consistency and partition tolerance
feynman_prompts: When should you choose a relational database over a document-oriented NoSQL database?
key_misconceptions: Using document databases for deeply interconnected multi-table relational data

nodes.title: Real-Time Systems: WebSockets & SSE
nodes.subtitle: Full-duplex WebSockets, Server-Sent Events (SSE), connection management, heartbeats
learning_objectives: Implement low-latency bidirectional communication using WebSockets
Handle socket reconnections, heartbeats, and client disconnect cleanup
feynman_prompts: When should you use Server-Sent Events (SSE) instead of full-duplex WebSockets?
key_misconceptions: Polling a REST API every 500ms instead of using a WebSocket or SSE connection

nodes.title: Background Tasks & Asynchronous Queues
nodes.subtitle: Celery, BullMQ, Redis Streams, task serialization, retries, dead-letter queues
learning_objectives: Offload heavy report generation and external API calls to background worker pools
Configure exponential backoff retries and dead-letter queues for failed jobs
feynman_prompts: Why is a dead-letter queue (DLQ) essential when processing background messages?
key_misconceptions: Executing multi-minute processing tasks synchronously inside HTTP request threads

nodes.title: Message Brokers & Event-Driven Architecture
nodes.subtitle: RabbitMQ, Apache Kafka, pub/sub, message persistence, consumer groups, idempotency
learning_objectives: Architect decoupled event-driven microservices using publish/subscribe patterns
Design idempotent event consumers that handle duplicate message deliveries safely
feynman_prompts: Why must event consumers be designed to be idempotent in distributed systems?
key_misconceptions: Assuming message brokers guarantee exactly-once delivery without consumer deduplication

nodes.title: Containerization with Docker
nodes.subtitle: Dockerfiles, layers, multi-stage builds, container networking, docker-compose
learning_objectives: Author secure, lightweight multi-stage Dockerfiles for backend services
Orchestrate multi-container local development environments with Docker Compose
feynman_prompts: Why do multi-stage Docker builds produce significantly smaller and more secure images?
key_misconceptions: Running production Docker containers as the default root user

nodes.title: Web Servers & Reverse Proxies (Nginx)
nodes.subtitle: Nginx, reverse proxying, SSL termination, load balancing, rate limiting, gzip/brotli
learning_objectives: Configure Nginx as a reverse proxy for upstream application servers
Implement IP-based rate limiting and SSL termination at the edge
feynman_prompts: Why should an application server run behind a reverse proxy like Nginx rather than exposed directly?
key_misconceptions: Exposing backend application ports directly to the public internet

nodes.title: System Scalability & Load Balancing
nodes.subtitle: Horizontal vs vertical scaling, round-robin, least connections, sticky sessions, statelessness
learning_objectives: Design stateless backend architectures capable of horizontal auto-scaling
Configure load balancing algorithms and handle database connection pooling at scale
feynman_prompts: Why is session state storage inside application server memory an obstacle to horizontal scaling?
key_misconceptions: Storing uploaded user files on local server disks instead of cloud object storage

nodes.title: Backend Security & OWASP Top 10
nodes.subtitle: SQL injection, SSRF, IDOR, command injection, rate limiting, security headers
learning_objectives: Prevent SQL injection using parameterized queries and ORM binding
Protect against Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) and Insecure Direct Object References (IDOR)
feynman_prompts: How does parameterized SQL query execution guarantee immunity against SQL injection?
key_misconceptions: Concatenating user string input directly into SQL query statements

nodes.title: Observability: Logging, Metrics & Tracing
nodes.subtitle: Structured JSON logging, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus metrics, distributed trace IDs
learning_objectives: Implement structured logging with correlation IDs across microservice requests
Instrument golden metrics (latency, traffic, errors, saturation) with Prometheus
feynman_prompts: Why is p99 latency a far more critical metric for SLAs than average response time?
key_misconceptions: Printing unstructured string logs without request IDs or contextual timestamps

nodes.title: CI/CD Pipelines & Production Deployment
nodes.subtitle: GitHub Actions, automated test pipelines, health checks, zero-downtime rolling deploys
learning_objectives: Automate unit testing and container image publishing via GitHub Actions
Configure readiness and liveness health checks for zero-downtime deployments
feynman_prompts: What is the difference between a container liveness probe and a readiness probe?
key_misconceptions: Deploying new code versions to production without automated regression testing

description: Master Backend Developer with an industry-standard, comprehensive curriculum spanning 22 core and advanced milestones.
